query: Show me everything OS knows about {input_location}.
sql: (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.sites.ngd_sites WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.water.ngd_water_features_water WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.land.ngd_land WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.transport_features.ngd_road_track_or_path WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.structure.ngd_structure WHERE {input_location}) UNION ALL (SELECT osid, theme, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.structure.ngd_compound_structure WHERE {input_location})

query: Show me all the buildings that are within 1km of {{location:Romsey}}.
sql: WITH location_buffer AS (SELECT st_union_agg(st_buffer(geometry, 1000)) AS geometry FROM product_data_store.named_features.ngd_named_area_deduped WHERE name = 'Romsey') SELECT b.osid, b.description, b.geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building b, location_buffer lb WHERE st_intersects(b.geometry, lb.geometry);

query: Show me all commercial buildings that are within 5km of {{location:Romsey}}.

query: Show me all the buildings that are near {input_location}.
sql: SELECT osid, description, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE {input_location};

query: Show me buildings that are between 1km and 2km away from {{location:Romsey}}.

query: Which buildings in {input_location} already have solar panels?
sql: SELECT osid, description, roofmaterial_solarpanelpresence, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE roofmaterial_solarpanelpresence='Present' AND {input_location};

query: Show me homes in {input_location}.
sql: SELECT osid, description, buildinguse_addresscount_residential, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0' AND {input_location};
notes: "Home" is interpreted as any property within a building in which someone lives, i.e. there is at least one residential address.

query: Show me all buildings in {input_location} with at least one residential postal address.
sql: SELECT osid, description, buildinguse_addresscount_residential, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0 AND {input_location};

query: Where are houses in {input_location} that were built after 2000?
sql: SELECT osid, description, buildinguse_addresscount_residential, buildinguse_addresscount_total, buildingage_year, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0 AND buildinguse_addresscount_total = 1 AND buildingage_year >= 2000 AND {input_location};
notes: "House" is interpreted as a single residential dwelling. To avoid mixed use or multi-dwelling buildings, use address counts.

query: Where are buildings in {input_location} that were built in 1991?
sql: SELECT osid, buildingage_period, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE buildingage_period = '1990-1999' AND {input_location}
notes: Single year building age is mainly available after 1999, the range is approximate.

query: Where are houses in {input_location} that were built before 1960?
sql: SELECT osid, description, buildinguse_addresscount_residential, buildinguse_addresscount_tota, buildingage_period, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0 AND buildinguse_addresscount_total = 1 AND buildingage_period IN ('Pre-1837','Pre-1919','1837-1869','1870-1918','1919-1944','1945-1959') AND {input_location};

query: Which buildings in {input_location} have good solar power potential?
sql: SELECT osid, description, roofmaterial_solarpanelpresence, roofmaterial_primarymaterial, buildingage_period, roofshapeaspect_shape, roofshapeaspect_areafacingsouth_m2, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE  roofmaterial_solarpanelpresence = 'Not Present' AND roofmaterial_primarymaterial NOT IN ('Fabric', 'Glass or Polycarbonate', 'Mixed', 'Green Roof', 'Thatch', 'Unknown') AND buildingage_period IN ('1919-1944', '1945-1959', '1960-1979', '1980-1989', '1990-1999', '2000-2009', '2010-2019', '2020-2029', '2030-2039') AND roofshapeaspect_shape != 'Flat' AND roofshapeaspect_areafacingsouth_m2 > 0 AND {input_location};
notes: Requires assumptions about factors defining solar potential. See example: https://storymaps.arcgis.com/stories/452dccc011644a668cf0e674adb27dbe.

query: Show me the top 10 largest buildings by area in {input_location}.
sql: SELECT osid, description, geometry_area_m2, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE {input_location} ORDER BY geometry_area_m2 DESC LIMIT 10;

query: Which buildings in {input_location} are 3m or less above sea level?
sql: SELECT osid, description, height_absolutemin_m, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE height_absolutemin_m <= 3 AND {input_location};

query: Which buildings in {input_location} have at least 3 floors?
sql: SELECT osid, description, numberoffloors, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE numberoffloors >= 3 AND {input_location};

query: Find all the tall buildings that are over 18m or 7 storeys tall in {input_location}.

query: Show me buildings with flammable external material or roof in {input_location}.

query: Where are commercial buildings taller than 10 m in {input_location}?

query: Which residential buildings in {input_location} are likely hard to heat?

query: Show me buildings in {input_location} that are within 150m of a river.
sql: WITH buildings AS (SELECT osid, description, geometry, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE {input_location}), rivers AS (SELECT st_union_agg(st_buffer(w.geometry, 150)) AS geometry FROM product_data_store.water.ngd_water_features_water w, buildings b WHERE w.description IN ('Reeds In Watercourse', 'Watercourse') AND st_intersects(w.geometry, st_buffer(st_envelope(b.geometry), 150))) SELECT b.osid, b.description, b.geometry_wgs84 FROM buildings b, rivers r WHERE st_intersects(b.geometry, r.geometry)

query: Show me all the houses in {input_location} that are within a 20 minute walk of a hospital.
sql: WITH residential_buildings AS (  SELECT    osid,    description,    geometry,    geometry_wgs84  FROM    product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building  WHERE    buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0 AND {input_location}),buffered_hospitals AS (  SELECT    st_union_agg(st_buffer(geometry, 1600)) AS geometry  FROM    product_data_store.sites.ngd_sites  WHERE    description = 'Hospital')SELECT  rb.osid,  rb.description,  rb.geometry_wgs84FROM  residential_buildings rb    JOIN buffered_hospitals h      ON st_intersects(h.geometry, rb.geometry)

query: Show me all houses in {input_location} that are not within 2km of a library.
sql: WITH residential_buildings AS (SELECT osid, description, st_buffer(geometry, 2000) AS search_geometry, geometry_wgs84 FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE  buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0 AND {input_location}), libraries AS (SELECT osid, description, geometry FROM product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building WHERE description IN ('Library', 'Library And Museum')) SELECT rb.osid, rb.description, rb.geometry_wgs84 FROM residential_buildings rb LEFT ANTI JOIN libraries l ON st_intersects(rb.search_geometry, l.geometry)

query: What is the nearest school to each residence in {input_location}?
sql: WITH houses AS (  SELECT    osid,    buildinguse_oslandusetiera,    geometry,    st_buffer(geometry, 5000) AS search_geometry,    geometry_wgs84  FROM    product_data_store.buildings.ngd_building  WHERE   buildinguse_addresscount_residential > 0    AND {input_location}),sch_sites AS (  SELECT    osid,    description,    geometry  FROM    product_data_store.sites.ngd_sites  WHERE    description = 'School'    AND {input_location}),candidates AS (  SELECT    h.osid,    sch.osid AS near_osid,    h.geometry AS h_geometry,    sch.geometry AS sch_geometry,    h.geometry_wgs84  FROM    houses h      JOIN sch_sites sch        ON st_intersects(h.search_geometry, sch.geometry)),ranked AS (  SELECT    osid,    near_osid,    h_geometry,    sch_geometry,    geometry_wgs84,    st_distance(st_setsrid(h_geometry, 27700), st_setsrid(sch_geometry,27700)) AS distance_m,    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY osid ORDER BY st_distance(h_geometry, sch_geometry)) AS row_number  FROM    candidates)SELECT  osid,  near_osid,  geometry_wgs84FROM  rankedWHERE  row_number = 1
